agents.architecture_diagram_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph L0["L0 · Ingress and validation"]
        REQ([HTTP or MCP client])
        REQ --> EP[JiraAgent.process_query_interactive]
        EP --> VLD[validate_prompt]
        VLD --> TCTX[TicketToolsContext plus optional project_id]
        TCTX -.->|optional legacy API| LEG
    end
    subgraph L1["L1 · Intent detection"]
        TCTX --> RULE[analyze_intent rule-based]
        RULE --> UNK{Action unknown?}
        UNK -->|yes| LLMI[analyze_intent_with_llm]
        UNK -->|no| INTENT[ActionType and ticket_key]
        LLMI --> INTENT
    end
    subgraph L2["L2 · Direct processor router"]
        INTENT --> DP[direct_process]
        DP --> HASCTX{ConversationContext?}
        HASCTX -->|no| NOMEM[process_without_conversation]
        HASCTX -->|yes| AWAIT{State AWAITING_INFO?}
        AWAIT -->|yes| INFO[handle_info_response]
        AWAIT -->|no| EXT[extract_ticket_data into session]
        EXT --> RT{ActionType switch}
        RT -->|CREATE| PC[process_create_ticket]
        RT -->|UPDATE| PU[process_update_ticket]
        RT -->|SEARCH or UNKNOWN| PS[process_search_tickets]
        RT -->|GET_DETAILS| GD[get_details_tool]
        RT -->|SUBTASK| PST[process_create_subtask]
        RT -->|LINK| PL[process_link_issues]
        RT -->|ISSUE_REPORT| PIR[process_issue_report]
        RT -->|ANALYTICS| PA[process_analytics]
    end
    subgraph L3["L3 · External integrations"]
        PC --> JS[JiraService JIRA REST API]
        PU --> JS
        PS --> JS
        GD --> JS
        PST --> JS
        PL --> JS
        PIR --> JS
        PA --> JS
        INFO --> JS
        NOMEM --> JS
        PC --> AIS[AIService PwC GenAI LLM]
        PU --> AIS
        PS --> AIS
        INFO --> AIS
        NOMEM --> AIS
        PIR --> AIS
    end
    subgraph L4["L4 · Response delivery"]
        JS --> OUT[Structured JSON response]
        AIS --> OUT
        OUT --> RESP[Response delivery]
        OUT --> CSUM[conversation_summary when session]
    end
    subgraph L5["L5 · Legacy path optional"]
        LEG[JiraAgent.process_query]
        LEG --> LC[LangChain ReAct AgentExecutor]
        LC --> TOOLS[Jira LangChain tools]
        LC -->|on failure| FB[direct_process fallback]
        FB --> JS
        FB --> AIS
    end
